[[Image:Caralain Grass map.png|thumb|right|200px|Location]]
The '''Caralain Grass''' is an extensive area of plains lying almost in the exact center of the [[Westlands]], roughly equidistant from the [[Great Blight]], the [[Aryth Ocean]], the [[Spine of the World]] and the [[Sea of Storms]]. At its widest extent, the Caralain Grass extends for almost a thousand miles.

The plain is bordered by the [[River Haevin]] to the west, the [[Black Hills]] to the north and [[Braem Wood]], the [[River Erinin]] and the [[River Luan]] to the east, and the kingdom of [[Andor]] to the south.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Caralain Grass}}

The Caralain Grass was once more densely populated, with the kingdom of [[Coremanda]] (one of the [[Ten Nations]] destroyed in the [[Trolloc Wars]]) claiming its full extent. It was later divided between the kingdoms of [[Dal Calain]], [[Aldeshar]] and [[Caembarin]] during the [[Third Age#The Free Years|Free Years]]. 

After the [[War of the Hundred Years]], the plains were claimed by the kingdom of [[Caralain]], but Caralain grew desolate and depopulated, fading away after several centuries. There are some villages remaining in the area, but they owe no allegiance to anyone and are distrustful, where not openly hostile, to strangers.{{ref/book|3|9}}

Nonetheless, Caralain Grass is largely unpopulated at present, and few venture across it save occasional caravans of the ''[[Tuatha'an]]''.

==Activities==

* In [[The Eye of the World]], [[Perrin Aybara]] and [[Egwene al'Vere]] flee [[Shadar Logoth]] into the Caralain Grass on the opposite side of the [[Arinelle]] from Andor. It is there where they encounter  [[Elyas Machera]]. They were initially heading away from their intended destination of [[Caemlyn]] before Elyas corrects them and they reenter Andor at some later point.{{ref/book|13|34}}
* Egwene recalls the journey through the Caralain Grass with [[Verin Mathwin]], [[Nynaeve al'Meara]], [[Elayne Trakand]], [[Mat Cauthon]] and [[Hurin]] on the way from [[Falme]] to [[Tar Valon]]. Twice Hurin warned them to leave a village after being there less than an hour. In the first instance, they didn't listen and the innkeeper and two other men tried to murder them in their beds and rob them. In the second instance, Verin didn't allow them to stick around to find out.{{ref/book|3|9}}
* [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]] retrieves King [[Alsalam Saeed Almadar]] of [[Arad Doman]] from "somewhere in the Caralain Grass".{{ref/book|13|13}} It is uncertain why he was there and how Cadsuane knew of his location.
* In [[The Shadow Rising]], the Caralain Grass is the source of [[the wind]]. It also flows across the area in [[The Gathering Storm]].{{ref/book|4|1}}{{ref/book|12|1}}
